mapper.select: select ifnull(sum(amount), 0) from zjudg_order_payment where pay_status = '1' and paid_time >= #{begin} and paid_time < #{end}
select count(1) from zjudg_order_payment where pay_status = '1' and paid_time >= #{begin} and paid_time < #{end}

select ifnull(sum(refund_amount), 0) from zjudg_refund where refund_status in ('0', '1') and create_time >= #{begin} and create_time < #{end}

select date_format(paid_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as stat_date, ifnull(sum(amount), 0) as amount from zjudg_order_payment where pay_status = '1' and paid_time >= #{begin} and paid_time < #{end} group by date_format(paid_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by stat_date

select date_format(paid_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as stat_date, count(1) as total from zjudg_order_payment where pay_status = '1' and paid_time >= #{begin} and paid_time < #{end} group by date_format(paid_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by stat_date

select date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as stat_date, count(distinct user_id) as total from sys_user where del_flag = '0' and status = '0' and create_time >= #{begin} and create_time < #{end} group by date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by stat_date

select date_format(l.login_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as stat_date, count(distinct u.user_id) as total from sys_login_info l inner join sys_user u on u.user_name = l.user_name where l.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0' and u.status = '0' and l.login_time >= #{begin} and l.login_time < #{end} group by date_format(l.login_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by stat_date

select date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as stat_date, ifnull(sum(refund_amount), 0) as amount from zjudg_refund where refund_status = '2' and create_time >= #{begin} and create_time < #{end} group by date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by stat_date
